title: Unified international HR information system (website success story)
description: Centralised HRIS for an international organisation with a MuleSoft integration layer giving real-time, two-way flows between SAP SuccessFactors, Talent Connect and local payroll systems; OliveSoft also runs the platform.
company_role: Integration design and delivery (15+ MuleSoft applications), CI/CD, continuous testing, hyper-care, then Run phase (monitoring, access control, updates).
scope: SAP SuccessFactors, Talent Connect, local payroll systems, MuleSoft, CI/CD pipeline.
outcomes: More than 15 MuleSoft applications in production; run phase managed by OliveSoft.
